settings.question: How does the bundle pricing work?
settings.answer: One squishy is £9.99. Add any two to your basket and you pay £16.99; add any three and you pay just £19.99. Mix and match any styles — the discount applies automatically at checkout, no code needed.

settings.question: What is a slow-rise squishy?
settings.answer: Squishies are made from ultra-soft polyurethane foam. Squeeze one and it slowly rises back to its original shape over about five seconds — the satisfying part that makes them so good for fidgeting and stress relief.

settings.question: What age are they suitable for?
settings.answer: Our squishies are designed for ages 3 and up, and are just as popular with grown-ups at their desks. They're non-toxic and phthalate-free.

settings.question: Will it lose its squish?
settings.answer: Made from dense, high-rebound foam — far thicker than novelty squishies — yours stays soft and springy through thousands of squeezes. Keep it away from sharp objects and direct sunlight for best results.

settings.question: What if I don't love it?
settings.answer: Every order is covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not happy, we'll refund you in full — no questions asked.
